constraints: 1 <= commands <= 1024; zero terminator; reset each game
independentMethod: Rotate per-face three-dimensional normal vectors instead of permuting face-position slots.

mutations.label: Uses the south rotation for north
mutations.find: face = {old[3], old[2], old[0], old[1], old[4], old[5]};
mutations.replace: face = {old[2], old[3], old[1], old[0], old[4], old[5]};

mutations.label: Uses the west rotation for east
mutations.find: face = {old[4], old[5], old[2], old[3], old[1], old[0]};
mutations.replace: face = {old[5], old[4], old[2], old[3], old[0], old[1]};
